facts._source: HealthCare.gov dates & glossary (verified 2026-10-05); 2026 HHS guidelines are used for 2027 premium tax credits; enhanced credits expired 2025-12-31 (not extended as of late Jul 2026)
facts._note_molina: 2027 Florida ACA exits: ONLY Cigna is confirmed (KFF 'Tracking Insurer Participation Changes in 2027', insurer info as of Jul 2 2026, published Oct 7: FL = Cigna exit only; Cigna announced Apr 30 2026, 369k members in 11 states). Sunshine State Health Plan = a legal entity behind Ambetter (Centene press release Nov 2025); reported move to another Centene entity, brand continues (single broker source, unconfirmed). Molina FL exit: only ACASignups (rate filings); KFF does not list it; Molina says it is cutting from 14 to 6 states without naming them. Sunshine/Molina CMS Plan switch on Oct 1 2026 is MEDICAID/CHIP (AHCA), unrelated to the Marketplace. Re-verify on HealthCare.gov plan data from Nov 1.
